newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil car output up 24.75 pct in Jan vs yr ago. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil car output up 24.75 pct in Jan vs yr ago. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the headline and the text to show that the output was up 24.75 percent in January from a year ago, instead of 2.99 percent.)
Brazilian car output reached 136,429 vehicles in January, up 24.75 percent from the same month last year, Brazil's Motor Manufacturers Association (Anfavea) said.
January output also rose 2.99 (corrects figure from 24.75) percent from the 132,472 vehicles assembled in December, it said.
